So what is HRV?
HRV is a measure of your autonomic nervous system that is widely considered one of the best objective metrics for physical fitness and determining your body’s readiness to perform.

Although HRV manifests as a function of your heart rate, it actually originates from your nervous system. Your autonomic nervous system, which controls the involuntary aspects of your physiology, has two branches, parasympathetic (deactivating) and sympathetic (activating).

The parasympathetic branch (often referred to as “rest and digest”) handles inputs from internal organs, like digestion or your fingernails and hair growing. It causes a decrease in heart rate. The sympathetic branch (often called “fight or flight”) reflects responses to things like stress and exercise, and increases your heart rate.

Heart rate variability comes from these two competing branches simultaneously sending signals to your heart. If your nervous system is balanced, your heart is constantly being told to beat slower by your parasympathetic system, and beat faster by your sympathetic system. This causes a fluctuation in your heart rate: HRV.

Dr. Portuese is a leading facial plastic surgeon in the Pacific Northwest serving patients in Seattle, Bellevue, Portland, Spokane, Vancouver, Anchorage and more.

Whether you're interested in undergoing a cosmetic procedure, or just curious, this app will help you become informed of your choices and expected outcomes of cosmetic facial plastic surgery.

Through this app you can:
* View over 100 before and after photos from Dr. Portuese's practice showing surgical outcomes of all types of facial cosmetic procedures
* Take your own photo using the iPhone's camera and sculpt your nose or chin to visualize what you may look like after a rhinoplasty (nose rehsaping) or chin augmentation procedure
* Get access to exclusive video interviews with Dr. Portuese discussing the facial cosmetic procedures offered at the Seattle Facial Plastic Surgery Center and the state of the art medical facilities and expertise available
* Send your own photo to Dr. Portuese for evaluation and easily get in touch with his friendly staff to learn more or setup a consultation

Dr. Portuese's practice can also be visited on the web at seattlefacial.com, portlandfacial.com and drnoseknows.com.

Please note that this app is informational only. It is not intended for diagnosis and treatment of any health condition, nor is it a substitute for in-office, professional medical advice. Please use this app in an environment, location, device, and account that supports your comfort and need for privacy.
